decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered out the accessories like cases, straps, and adapters to focus on actual Bluetooth speakers. I selected a consideration set that represents a range of quality and price points, from the ultra-portable JBL Go 3 to the high-end Sony SRS-XB43. I chose the Sony SRS-XB43 as my final choice because it offers the most robust feature set, including IP67 waterproofing, 24-hour battery life, and superior sound quality with the 'Extra Bass' feature, which justifies the higher price for a long-term audio investment.
